messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — we need a go/no-go on the triple-play integration announcement (Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB partner). Thinking joint marketplace listing + a coordinated partner blog + SI enablement push. Can we confirm timeline and owners?

matt_g: Timeline note — Snowflake marketplace review typically takes 10 business days for legal/terms. If we want a joint go-live in early May we need paperwork by next Tue.

jordan: SI/solutions update — demo kit + runbook are the blockers on our side. I can build the demo kit but need a sample dataset and a validated connector binary from eng.

selena: Hardware partner (DVX) update — certification tests passed but FW update 1.2.3 still needs to be pushed to partner staging. DVX says ~72h once we hand off.

alyssa: Proposal: dry-run with partners + SI on Fri 2025-04-25, internal dress rehearsal 48h before. If we do that, public announce 2025-04-28. Any objections?

samir-bot: calendar-bot created invite: <https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/3xYz> for 2025-04-23 10:00 PT (internal rehearsal).

emily: Docs/devex — I'll prep a lightweight quickstart and a `connector.yaml` sample. Draft will include:
```
name: redwood-snow-vector
version: 0.1
source: snowflake://<account>/db.schema
target: qdrant://host:6333
mapping: auto
```
I'll post it to the partner repo and link in the invite.

matt_g: Messaging questions: we need a short bullet list for partner comms re: SLA, data residency, and which SKU this maps to (Hosted vs Dedicated). Who owns that copy? :thinking_face:

selena: I can draft the hardware footnote + compatibility matrix. Will add a line about FW requirement and supported GPU families.

jordan: QA plan: I'll run two sample passes — one retail small (10k docs) and one large-ish (retail-1m) to validate batching/kv-cache behavior across Snowflake -> frontend -> vector DB. Can we get a test Snowflake account loaded with the 10k payload by Wed?

alyssa: Sounds good. Action items: matt finalize partner legal timeline, emily publish quickstart by Wed EOD, selena push FW to DVX staging, jordan prepare QA harness. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll lock dates and notify partners.

matt_g: +1 to locking. I'll ping Snowflake legal now. :thumbsup:

alyssa: Thanks — will follow up with a short status thread after legal reply.
